name: TOMO GTA VI Clipping (Clipping Nation)
pay: $2.00 / 1K views, min 2,000 views, max $150 per video, Content Rewards keeps 10%
brief: Feature Tomo; source mainly his GTA VI YouTube livestreams or GTA VI videos. Priority: funny moments and first reactions to GTA VI (new features, cars, places, missions), stunts, chases, fails, interactions.
One clear moment; cut anything that needs more than a few seconds of context. Hook in the first 2 seconds.
CTA in every clip: mention Tomo and where to watch more (on-screen CTA at the end + caption).
Captions readable without sound. English only.
Accurate titles and captions: no misleading titles, fake context or clickbait. Never portray Tomo in a negative light.
No low-effort clips: no plain screen recordings, random moments, or clips without a clear purpose.
No AI-generated content or thumbnails. Never post the same or nearly identical clip more than 5 times.
Clip must stay live at least 30 days; likes must stay visible.
Submit the link within 30 minutes of posting. After 2,000 views, send the audience country breakdown (>= 40% Tier 1: US, UK, CA, AU) to the Clipping Nation Discord support chat.

Post only on the owner's GTA 6-specific TikTok or YouTube Shorts account (GTAVI_CLIP6), connected in Content Rewards. NOT Instagram. No paid-partnership tag needed.
Submit the public link immediately, while the post is less than 30 minutes old. A post goes to one campaign only.
